Dress her in a rich coral-red short-sleeved summer dress with a secure soft-square neckline, fitted fabric waist and gently flared knee-length skirt; small turquoise drop earrings. She has just turned while walking, torso oriented toward the opposite side from the reference, head turning toward the viewer. One hand makes a small natural greeting beside the shoulder; the other trails gently beside the skirt. Both feet are grounded in an easy crossing step, no lifted back foot. Warm breeze lifts golden curls and only the outer hem. Frame from hair to below knees, making her face large and clear like the reference. Turquoise summer sky, sunlit cream and golden daisies, touches of cobalt foliage shadow and coral petals; a painted flower path recedes softly. Clear gold sunlight on face and hair, beautiful saturated natural colors, crisp expressive face and fabric folds.
